query_plan.query: What is the average area of US states in square kilometers?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by state id so each state appears once, then return a single value: the average area over all states.
steps.query: Return all US states together with their area, with their state id and state name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(area_km2) AS avg_area FROM states

s1.sql_query: SELECT states.state, states.name, states.area_km2 FROM states
